neighbours.label: a small digit token given as a value in code or a parameter default, most of all '2'
fire: The optional power argument defaults to 2.
beta: the weight used in the loss. Default: 2.
Set the number of workers to 3 in the config file.
The call uses padding = 2 on the inner layer.
An exponent of 2 gives the usual squared error.
quiet: The optional power argument defaults to false.
beta: the weight used in the loss. Default: none.
Set the number of workers to auto in the config file.
The call uses padding = same on the inner layer.
An exponent of zero gives the usual constant error.

notes: Weak pole (max 1.87), card flags it broad and in the gate-closed regime. Prose digits are weaker. '(y' and '(a' in code fired about 0.48 in probes, so the near misses avoid a bare open bracket before an identifier.
